name: UAVGroundControlStation
description: Ground control station using MAVLink telemetry from TX16S/ELRS

paragraphs: A local ground control station for UAVs — map, telemetry, and serial link in one dashboard.
Website: uavgroundcontrolstation.com · Hosted Web App: app.uavgroundcontrolstation.com

UAV Ground Control Station is a slim, locally operated GCS that runs on the operator’s machine. A shared React UI shows position, battery, radio link, flight mode, and session stats on a MapLibre map — whether data arrives over CRSF, MAVLink, or both.
features: Live map with flight track (up to 5000 points), home reference, distance, heading-aligned drone chevron (falls back to a circle when heading is unknown), bottom-center Attitude HUD (pitch ladder, roll arc, heading tape,…

Telemetry sidebar — Text or Inst (mini gauges with the same telemetry fields as text mode); drag card headers (⠿) to reorder (shared order for both views, stored in uav-gcs.sidebar.order); Reset restores recommended…
Serial link — port picker (USB/PNP preferred), manual path entry, common baud rates
Activity log — connection status, parser stats, frame message stats; actionable link-issue banners for serial denial, busy ports, silence after connect, and parser spikes
Optional video stream (MJPEG, etc.) via environment variables; crosshair overlay; when the stream is live, a Ground Target panel docks beside the camera feed

whatItDoes.text: A local ground control station for UAVs — map, telemetry, and serial link in one dashboard.

requirements.text: Self-host the Hosted Web App with pnpm build:cloud and serve apps/web/dist from that command only — not the output of pnpm build (desktop/Node stack).
